title: Ethics board review of gift guide and gift laws
summary: In November 2024 the Board of Ethics voted six to zero to form a small working group to check whether its gift guide is adequate. The group is to suggest improvements to the gift law.

timeline.text: Motion to reconstitute the PIG on gift guidelines: The board formed a new working group to recommend updated gift guidelines for county departments and employees.
Motion to dissolve the PIG on gifts established May 14, 2025: The board dissolved the gift guidelines working group it set up in May 2025.
Motion to form a small working group on the gift guide: The board voted to form a small working group to review its gift guide and suggest changes to gift laws.
A member said a small working group would check if the board's gift guide is adequate and suggest improvements to the law.
